digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery and state reporting
propositions: A failed tickets-branch push is unobservable on async, library, and MCP write paths due to stderr discarding, missing logging handlers, and result-only responses.
The async path spawns a detached child with start_new_session=True and DEVNULL stderr, so all warnings from a declined push are discarded by the OS.
Library embedders using rebar.comment() receive no signal when a push is declined because install_stderr_handler is CLI/MCP-only and NullHandler absorbs logs.
MCP write tools return only {result: "ok"} to the agent even when the push was declined, and server-side stderr is never visible to the caller.
A durable marker stored in the git directory and recorded at the _raise_if_strict choke point makes push-rejection state observable across all paths without changing exit codes or raising exceptions.
The push_status field on MCP write-tool outputs as a strict superset of {result: string} surfaces the delivery state to agents without breaking the existing contract.
